title: S01T04 - Define SemVer, schema compatibility, migration, and rollback contracts
description: Turn current version-skew and migration behavior into a published support matrix covering machine binaries, repo pins, storage/schema versions, upgrade order, backups, and rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: A version-support matrix defines compatible CLI, runtime, schema, storage, and installed-skill versions.
Every nontrivial migration has a preflight, backup or snapshot, content-parity check, and tested rollback path.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.

dirtyPathNotes: git_unavailable: compatibility policy, migration logic, tests, and tracker state remain uncommitted because the managed session denies creation of .git/index.lock

closedReason: SemVer, schema compatibility, migration, content parity, backup, and rollback contracts are implemented, documented, and tested.
